observation: Ravi scans the QR stand with his phone; Meera works calmly at an empty reception desk behind him. Inspected at 25% (contact sheet), 100% (full panel) and 200% (face crops), and on the composed page.

anatomy.note: Ravi in profile facing right: far (left) arm extended with the phone to the stand, watch on that wrist; near (right) arm relaxed and empty at his side.

contact.note: Phone held near the stand in his left hand; Meera's hands on the keyboard.

objects.note: QR stand matches page 3: teal frame on a pole, white screen with an abstract grey QR-like grid (redrawn, tools/qr-stand-fix.py); phone shows a scan frame and a check mark; no text.

faces.note: Faces match the sheets at 200%; see faceIdentity.

linework.note: Consistent; the moved watch and the restored right wrist show no patch edge at 200%.

background.note: Reception desk with monitor, glass doors and window; full image height kept and the sides cropped (tools/pad-canvas.py crop-sides), so no padded band.

continuity.note: Meera matches (braid over her left shoulder, blue kurta, bangle on the right wrist); no queue at the desk; Ravi without bag; watch moved to his left wrist (tools/watch-move.py) to match the cast.

lettering.note: Four-line caption on the plain desk front at the lower left, below Meera and left of Ravi; clear of faces and hands.

issues.description: First take drew the receptionist as a nurse and gave Ravi his bag with phone and watch on the wrong hands; retake fixed all three.

Review r20: padded top showed streaks and the stand screen differed from page 3; review r21: the watch was on his near right wrist. Fixed by full-height crop, stand-screen redraw and moving the watch to the left wrist.

thick straight dark brows close to the eyes

round face with full cheeks and short chin; braid over her left shoulder
